name: The Apple of my eye
source:
Realizing that Klubnichka does not fit in at all with the other girls in the valley, she grows a strawberry clone for herself. As she feels a bond with her new friend, she distances herself even further from the others.

But what will Yablochka say about this, so certain of Klubnichka's feelings for her?

[From [url=https://veterblin.itch.io/the-apple-of-my-eye]itch.io[/url]]
